title: Evangelion: The Original Films
short: Death & Rebirth and End of Evangelion
blurb: Two 1997 films that conclude the original television series, one a recap and one an alternative ending.
note: Death & Rebirth is largely a recap of the series plus the first half of the finale. End of Evangelion completes it. Watch the television series first. The Rebuild films are a separate retelling.
